verdicts.explanation: Both pages' profile entries show jsonld.malformed_blocks: 1, confirming a JSON-LD block on each page failed to parse.
The homepage's own JSON-LD carries no sameAs links (jsonld.sameas is empty), so the brand has nothing here that anchors it to an external profile.

site_specific: Run the pricing page's application/ld+json blocks (breadcrumb and webpage schema) through a JSON validator before publishing.
Fix the syntax error so all blocks parse; a malformed block is discarded entirely and provides no benefit.
Apply the same check to /mottoaligners/results, which has the same defect.
Add Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD to the homepage.
Include sameAs links to Aspen Dental's official social and reference profiles so an assistant can disambiguate the brand from others sharing the name.
